dna-structure.alt: Left: a nucleotide, a phosphate circle joined to the 5-prime carbon of a pentagon-shaped sugar, with a base rectangle on the 1-prime carbon. Right: four base pairs between two strands. The left strand runs 5-prime at the top to 3-prime at the bottom, the right strand 3-prime at the top to 5-prime at the bottom. A-T pairs have two dashed hydrogen bonds and G-C pairs three.
